summary: Principal Financial Group filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $400M 5.300% Senior Notes due 2037 under an automatic shelf registration statement. The notes are guaranteed by Principal Financial Services, Inc. and were sold via underwriters BofA, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard capital markets transaction.
